targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, route_template AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS requests FROM request_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, route_template ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Error rate by status class (2xx / 4xx / 5xx, stacked %)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, ((status_code / 100)::text || 'xx') AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS requests FROM request_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS rejections FROM request_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status_code = 429 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Latency per endpoint — p50 / p95 / p99 (ms, windowed percentile_cont)

targets.rawSql: SELECT route_template, COUNT(*)::int AS requests, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric(10,1) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric(10,1) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric(10,1) AS p99 FROM request_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY route_template ORDER BY p99 DESC;

panels.title: Overall p95 / p99 latency (ms, all endpoints, per minute)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p99 FROM request_telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
